week1Recap.Aidan O'Sullivan_Andrew Wilson: Aidan exploded for a league-best 144.46 behind 1.01 draft pick Jahmyr Gibbs and Nico Collins (2.24) to secure the #1 overall seed exiting Week 1. Andrew, the 3-time banner king OG, put up a stout 120.96 behind Ja'Marr Chase (1.3) and Javonte Williams (2.22) but suffered heartbreak as the highest-scoring loser *ever* in a Pride Guys Week 1. Aidan extends his active streak over L Central to 3 games (Wk1'26, 144.46-120.96).
week1Recap.Brendan Sanders_Brodie Pirtle: In the inaugural clash between the league's newest franchises, sophomore standout Brendan delivered 126.56 points anchored by Christian McCaffrey (1.5) and rookie Ashton Jeanty (2.20). Brodie's expansion squad BloodSword2000 showed formidable depth behind Justin Jefferson (1.8) and Derrick Henry (2.17), but couldn't keep pace in his franchise debut. Brendan secures the #2 seed entering Week 2.
week1Recap.Nathan Wells_Michael Anderson: Nathan pushed his active winning streak over OG Michael to 3 straight regular season matchups behind Bijan Robinson (1.2) and Brock Bowers (2.23). CTESPN, the most decorated manager in league history without a chip (5 career podium finishes), received solid outings from CeeDee Lamb (1.10) and Rashee Rice (2.15) but stalled at 107.00, dropping to 0-1.
week1Recap.Austin Geller_Sean Belcher: In a marquee battle of former champions, 2022 winner Austin rode Jaxon Smith-Njigba (1.7) and Kenneth Walker III (2.18) to an efficient 118.66. Sean, a 2x champion OG and 2025 runner-up, laid a dud with a league-low 92.72 as De'Von Achane (1.11) and Drake London (2.14) were held in check. Austin jumps to #4 while Sean sinks to #12.
week1Recap.Trace Bakulich_Phillip Busick: Pride Guys' all-time wins leader (68 regular season wins entering 2026) made quick work of Phil, stretching his winning streak to 3 games behind Jonathan Taylor (1.6) and Omarion Hampton (2.19). Joey Chestnuts couldn't find an offensive groove behind Puka Nacua (1.4) and A.J. Brown (2.21), managing just 94.70 to remain mired in the bottom tier.
week1Recap.Tyler Hicks_Dylan Soth: In the tightest matchup of Week 1, Tyler spoiled the reigning champion's banner-raising week with a gritty 6.52-point victory behind Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.9) and Chase Brown (2.16). Dylan, who rode a Cinderella run from the #5 seed to capture the 2025 title, got balanced contributions from James Cook (1.12) and Saquon Barkley (2.13) but fell just shy of the comeback.

week2Preview.Michael Anderson_Trace Bakulich: Both OGs entering their 10th season square off in one of Pride Guys' longest-tenured rivalries. Despite Michael holding a 10-8 regular season edge, these two founding pillars have miraculously *never* crossed paths in the postseason. Trace enters 1-0 looking to build an early cushion for top-two bye contention behind Jonathan Taylor (1.6) and Omarion Hampton (2.19). Michael is fighting to avoid a disastrous 0-2 start, needing CeeDee Lamb (1.10) and Rashee Rice (2.15) to produce a vintage offensive outburst.
week2Preview.Tyler Hicks_Nathan Wells: An early battle of unbeatens between two squads fresh off upset victories. Nathan has controlled the lifetime regular season series 5-2 and eliminated Tyler in their lone postseason clash (2022 Wild Card). Defense Contractor #1 looked lethal behind Bijan Robinson (1.2) and Brock Bowers (2.23) in Week 1. Tyler will count on Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.9) and Chase Brown (2.16) to prove his Week 1 takedown of the defending champ was the real deal.
week2Preview.Dylan Soth_Phillip Busick: High stakes in the basement as two 0-1 teams battle to avoid falling two games back of the playoff cutline. Reigning champion Dylan swept both head-to-head clashes against Phil last season (including a 35-point rout in Week 12) behind James Cook (1.12) and Saquon Barkley (2.13). Joey Chestnuts finished last in both 2024 and 2025 and desperately needs Puka Nacua (1.4) and A.J. Brown (2.21) to ignite his passing attack.
week2Preview.Austin Geller_Brendan Sanders: An undefeated showdown pitting the 2022 champion against 2025's breakout sophomore. Austin swept both regular season meetings last season on his way to securing the #1 seed (9-5) and owns the league's longest active playoff streak at 4 straight seasons. Brendan was clinical in Week 1 behind Christian McCaffrey (1.5) and Ashton Jeanty (2.20), and will look to avenge last year's sweep to establish himself as the early-season championship favorite.
week2Preview.Aidan O'Sullivan_Sean Belcher: Game of the Week: First place meets last place in a classic clash of Pride Guys royalty. Sean, a 2x champion OG, has historically owned Aidan with an 8-4 record and an active 4-game winning streak. But the narrative has flipped entering Week 2: Aidan sits atop the leaderboard with 144.46 points behind 1.01 Jahmyr Gibbs and Nico Collins (2.24), while Sean must resurrect a sputtering offense after finishing as the league's lowest scorer in Week 1.
week2Preview.Andrew Wilson_Brodie Pirtle: The league's 3-time banner king OG faces the expansion rookie for the first time *ever*. Andrew was unlucky in Week 1, dropping a high-scoring thriller despite 120.96 points from Ja'Marr Chase (1.3) and Javonte Williams (2.22). Brodie showed encouraging rookie firepower behind Justin Jefferson (1.8), Derrick Henry (2.17), and Tetairoa McMillan (3.32). Andrew will look to lean on veteran championship pedigree to avoid falling into an 0-2 hole.
